About the academy

A trusted driving institute for Kaikhali and Baguiati.

Atabul Driving Center is a trusted, professional driving training institute located in Kaikhali, Dakshin Maath, Baguiati, near GM Soroni. We provide high-quality driving education and reliable driver services to individuals and families in our local community.

With years of practical experience and a strong focus on safety, we help beginners become confident drivers and assist experienced learners in sharpening their road skills. Our goal is simple: every student feels comfortable, confident, and fully prepared for real-life driving situations.

Expert instructors Calm, patient, safety-first instruction on every drive.
Pickup points Convenient pickup across the Kaikhali-Baguiati area.
Always on time Scheduled sessions that respect your time.
Comfortable cars Well-maintained, clean, learner-friendly vehicles.

Training method

Four stages. One confident driver.

A structured path from first ignition to independent driving, with every stage signed off before you move ahead.

Stage 01

Basic vehicle introduction

Learn the essential parts and functions of the vehicle: steering control, gears, clutch, brake, accelerator, and basic safety checks, before you start.

Stage 02

Practical road training

Real driving experience on live roads under expert supervision: traffic rules, lane discipline, turning, overtaking, and safe technique.

Stage 03

Confidence & traffic handling

Build composure in busy traffic: smart decision-making, defensive driving, and smooth control in real-road situations.

Stage 04

Final skill assessment

A practical performance evaluation to make sure you are fully confident, safe, and ready for independent driving and licence approval.
